name: Neodymium
role: Rare-earth dopant (added as Nd2O3). Nd3+ (4f3, open-shell) substitutes Li+ aliovalently — creating charge-compensating Li vacancies — while its co-introduced O sits on an S site, forming P-O-Nd bridges. Oxophilic hard-acid anchor for O; local-distortion / Li-mobility lever; not a native SE element.

ionic_radius_A._note: Shannon 1976: Nd3+ VI (octahedral) 0.983 A, VIII 1.109 A. Much larger than Li+ (0.76) -> substituting Li+ forces local lattice distortion; smaller than Ba2+ (see Xiong BaSnF4 precedent) so it contracts/strengthens its own M-anion bond.

representative_compounds.battery_role: basic-oxide dopant/getter; source of Nd3+ + O; O-anchoring
representative_compounds.note: Basic oxide -> H2S getter archetype (air-stability) but at an ionic-conductivity cost; delivers O to the sulfide with Nd as the oxophilic carrier

representative_compounds.battery_role: O on S-site bridged to P and Nd; local oxysulfide (PS3O-like) unit
representative_compounds.note: HSAB: hard O2- binds hard Nd3+ -> Nd oxophilically anchors O; analogous to La-O in La+O dual-doped argyrodite (Yang 2025)

representative_compounds.battery_role: wide-gap insulating decomposition product; alternative Nd source
representative_compounds.note: Preserved under Li-metal reduction (robust Nd-Cl ionic bond) -> contributes to electron-blocking, Li+-passing SEI

representative_compounds.battery_role: Nd-in-phosphate high-voltage structural motif; possible wide-gap interphase
representative_compounds.note: Resonates with P-O-Nd bridge chemistry; Nd3+ in phosphate lattices gives structural/thermal stability

sei_relevance: Nd is a rare-earth dopant, not an intrinsic SE ion. Function split (from our Nd/O mechanism map): O does the oxidative/moisture stabilization (with a documented sigma penalty), Nd3+ is the oxophilic hard-acid carrier/anchor for that O (P-O-Nd) plus a basic-oxide air-stability getter and microstructure modifier. Aliovalent Nd3+ -> Li+ substitution injects Li vacancies (carrier concentration lever) and the large Nd3+ radius distorts the local cage (Li-mobility lever). For the SEI: Nd2O3 / NdCl3 / NdPO4 are all wide-gap insulators expected to survive Li-metal reduction -> a self-limiting, electron-blocking, Li+-conductive passivation layer (Xiong BaSnF4 SEI argument transferred). Standalone Nd gap/sigma effects are neutral-to-negative -> classic RE/oxide 'stability-for-conductivity' trade.

xps.assignment: Nd3+ in Nd2O3 (main line; unscreened 3d9 4f3 final state; reported ~981.5-982.5 eV)
xps.ref: XPS databases (xpsdatabase.com Z=60); Nd niobate/tantalate XPS study

xps.assignment: NOTE: Nd 3d shows multiplet + charge-transfer satellites from 3d-hole x 4f3 coupling; use as Nd3+ survival probe (O-doping / P-O-Nd)

raman.assignment: Nd3+ is not a primary Raman probe in this context (no diagnostic battery mode identified); Nd environment is tracked via XPS (Nd 3d) and DFT+U PDOS (Nd 4f) instead of Raman. Omitted rather than invented.

dos_character: Nd carries a localized, open-shell 4f3 configuration (S=3/2, ground term 4I9/2). PBE/PBE+U mis-place the 4f manifold and give a wrong gap/DOS, so the Nd 4f states REQUIRE DFT+U (Dudarev formulation) with spin-polarization (ISPIN=2); literature U_eff on Ln 4f ~6 eV (Loschen 2007; Topsakal & Wentzcovitch 2014). In Nd2O3 the optical/edge transition is O 2p -> Nd 4f upper Hubbard band. The 4f shell is contracted and shielded by 5s2 5p6 (spectator), so Nd bonds via 5d/6s; the 4f local moment should be projected EXPLICITLY (projwfc onto Nd 4f, spin-resolved) to expose the 3 unpaired electrons rather than hidden as core. CAMPAIGN NOTE: the Xiong BaSnF4 study treated 4f as core with no spin/+U — our protocol deliberately corrects this (ISPIN=2 + DFT+U on 4f3).
key_references: Xiong et al., J. Power Sources 2022, 518, 230718 — Nd-doped BaSnF4 DFT (Nd-M-anion distortion lowers migration barrier); our critique: it omits ISPIN=2 and DFT+U on 4f3, which our Nd-argyrodite protocol requires (db/literature/refs.json:xiong2022)
Loschen et al. 2007; Topsakal & Wentzcovitch 2014 — U_eff (~6 eV) on lanthanide 4f
Dudarev et al., Phys. Rev. B 1998, 57, 1505 — rotationally-invariant DFT+U formulation
Rare-earth sesquioxides via semi-local + DMFT, arXiv:2110.00400 — Nd2O3 gap = O 2p -> 4f upper Hubbard band
Yang et al., Electrochim. Acta 2025 — La+O dual-doped argyrodite via LaCl3 (closest sulfide-argyrodite rare-earth precedent; P-O-La bridges analogous to our P-O-Nd) (litdb)
Nd 3d XPS: Nd2O3 3d5/2 ~981.5-982.5 eV, 3d3/2 ~1005 eV (XPS databases; neodymium niobate/tantalate study)
